evidence.quote: Torrent Pharma is a 53-year-old pharmaceutical company that has evolved from a domestic player into a diversified global branded generics business.

It is the flagship company of the Torrent Group with a strong presence across: India (largest market, 54% of revenue — #5 in IPM), USA (10% — branded + generic formulations), Brazil (10% — branded generics), Germany (9% — generics), Others (17% — includes emerging markets).

Torrent Pharma develops, manufactures, and markets pharmaceutical formulations — primarily branded generics (74% of revenue), plus generic generics in the US and Germany, and a growing Consumer Health (CHC) segment.
The JB Pharma acquisition (Jan 2026) is transformational — moved them from #7 to #5 in IPM, added 6 iconic brands, and opened new therapy areas.
Revenue 5-year CAGR of ~12% is healthy for a company of this scale.
The Indian pharmaceutical industry's rise is itself a proven global precedent: Indian pharma exports grew from ~$3B (2000) to ~$28B+ (2025).
The Patent Cliff Wave (2023–2028): Global patents worth an estimated $200B+ are expiring between 2023 and 2028.
Torrent is well-positioned for the current patent cliff: Semaglutide (GLP-1 for diabetes/obesity) — Torrent has launched both oral and injectable formulations post-patent expiry.
Torrent's own US business grew 31% in FY26, proving market access.
The company is an integrated pharma company (manufacturing + marketing + distribution).
